instructions: Fresh review of each primary candidate: read dialogue first, then exact cards. Assess all six unchanged criteria and all coach-2.0 gates with turn-specific evidence. For pairs, show whether the Stance changes HOW A pursues the Drive in one interaction. Do not invent missing backstory or assume prior approval. Use the alternate only to assess meaningful differentiation. Report actual reservations. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
productionStandard:
PRODUCTION STANDARD coach-2.0. Historical coach-1.0 acceptance is not coach-2.0 acceptance. Read the dialogue first and record what the spoken words establish before interpreting the card. Exact cards are already in this invocation: label internal-dialogue-first, never blind or human review. Do not invent a charitable backstory; harmless unspecified names/history are not defects. Fill coach2 for ORIGINAL dialogue in writer output and CANDIDATE dialogue in reviewer output. Copy the supplied dialogue hash for the text being assessed. Give concise actual turn evidence, not generic claims.
G1: legible immediate situation, wants/stakes; separate stated, ordinary inferred, and missing essentials. Identify first material defect or explicitly none.
G2: coherent facts, ownership, timing, language, knowledge; recognizable misunderstanding/revelation is allowed, unstated intervening events are not.
G3: assess all A1-B2, B2-A3, A3-B4, B4-A5 links. Vocabulary repetition alone is insufficient. Purposeful avoidance must read as behavior.
G4: B is a plausible participant with an intelligible practical/emotional position, not a contrived punchline cue. B can help, concede or solve.
G5: exact card changes A's choices. For pairs Stance changes HOW A pursues Drive and B responds to the merged behavior; neither card may be decorative.
G6: ending develops the same behavior using B4. Investigate if A5 would work after unrelated B4; more obstacles are not required for heightening.
format: five spoken ABABA turns, existing word/schema limit, no narration/coaching/truncation.
Every mandatory gate and transition is PASS, FAIL or UNCLEAR with evidence; UNCLEAR cannot be accepted. All gates pass AND total >=85 AND fidelity/response >=4 AND others >=3; preserve the six weights 30/20/15/15/10/10. A 5 is not merely presence. Totals are derived in code. Retain good originals; no rewrite quota. Review both alternatives for different tactics, relationships or pressure. Scene outline identifies roles, task, A want, B want, stakes, exact-card tactic and B's contribution; it is private planning evidence, not a substitute for missing spoken facts. Humour must come from sincere priorities and responsive choices, not stock hierarchy or unrelated slogans. Record actual weaknesses and reservations. Writer corrections target only rejected/materially changed scenes; preserve all accepted records and prior original assessments exactly. No coach-1.0 failure or exhausted allowance is erased by this separately versioned cycle.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Choose the Relationship
cards.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let work ring. I've reserved these ten minutes for choosing our wedding vows.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The client won't sign unless I'm there. Can I go?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not yet. I'm about to promise you my whole life; the client may wait while we finish this page.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask Maya to keep him occupied for ten minutes. She'll want a reason.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell her you have a prior commitment with me. I approve putting that in your calendar; our promises deserve an appointment too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've set your place at home tonight. I finally learned your mother's dumplings; the networking dinner can proceed without you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director's coming. I could get promoted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your promotion campaign may resume tomorrow. Tonight I want you choosing us, not collecting a hot plate between appointments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll freeze them. We can eat together tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That postponement isn't approved. You used it on our anniversary. Call the dinner organizer and say you already have a commitment with me.

cards.title: Remember Me Correctly
cards.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you take the tea through, which cup is mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you just take one? Everyone's waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Twelve years of breakfast together. Which one have I always used?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The blue one. Your name's underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Correct, but turn it upright. How much milk? I haven't written that on the handle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you caption our holiday photo, what did I say when we missed that boat?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember you laughing. Not the words.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'll start you off: 'Well, that's the last time we trust...'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I just write 'Happy memories'?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's try multiple choice. Your watch, my French, or the man selling us watches?

cards.title: Let Go of the Grudge
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put your place beside mine for dinner. I missed your opening night, but I want us sitting together tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You left my seat empty. You can have an empty one now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll accept the complaint, not the seating plan. Bring your plate over; you can be angry beside me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm still going to tell you every bit you missed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The floor is yours. Sit here and start with the first scene. I'm not asking you to pretend it didn't hurt; I'm asking you to stop eating it alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your ban on me carrying boxes is up for review. I missed your birthday, but I want to help you move today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I needed you then. You didn't show.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That point is accepted. You may choose the first thing I'm trusted with, but don't rule out every box before I've lifted one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The birthday glasses. Still wrapped, since nobody came.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then those travel in my hands. You may watch every step. At your new place, give me the chance to put two of them on the table with you.

cards.title: I Pulled Away First
cards.instruction: Hide your role in creating the distance while working urgently to repair it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your taxi can wait five minutes. I've arranged for us to restart our letters; here's paper and stamps.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You never answered my last three.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Complaints about the post are noted. We're bypassing it today; you may write yours at this end of the table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I handed you the last one. Are you going to blame the table?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm assigning myself the first letter. Sit there and inspect it as I write. I want you leaving with a reply in your hand, not another postal investigation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your new key is approved for both doors. Come in now; I've made your favorite lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You changed the lock without telling me. Why?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're discussing the new key. You may test both doors while the food is hot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already tested the old one on my birthday. I stood outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I authorize a birthday lunch today. Let yourself into the kitchen; I'll find candles. We can start with a door that opens and a meal together.

cards.title: Not Why We Drifted
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved this spot for our picnic. Same sandwiches as our last afternoon here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The afternoon you said we needed space?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: More space is approved too. We can move the blanket under that tree.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moving won't stop me asking why you pulled away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll stay. You may question the mustard; that belongs on today's agenda. Tell me if I've finally made the sandwiches the way you like.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've selected our wedding video for tonight. You may choose where we start.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather discuss why we're living separately.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That isn't one of the chapters. I've approved your father's speech; we never settled what he meant by 'good luck'.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He meant this. Pause it. I don't want another speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pause granted. You may choose dancing instead; no speeches there. We can finally decide whether your uncle falls into the cake.
